does: Clears the roll view model before a new roll is shown: the chance, the difficulty class, the result and the phase (set to 5), each change deferred to the UI.

evidence.says: zeroes +0x48, +0x100 (Chance) and +0xD0 (DifficultyCheck) and sets the phase byte to 5, each with ui::deferred::PropertiesManager::DeferPropertyChanged

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a dialogue was on (segments 4, 16, 31, 32), 5 times from 1 place, the active-roll title code at code:unplaced::SetUpActiveRollTitle
